errors.session_unsaved: The database is not open, so this session is not kept after it stops or the app quits.
errors.sync_paused_metered: Sync paused. You're on a metered connection, so Tidepool waits for Wi-Fi. Resume now from the menu bar if you'd rather not wait.
help.snapshots: Tidepool takes a snapshot every hour. Tidepool keeps each one for 30 days. Tidepool then keeps one a day for a year. Tidepool stores snapshots on this Mac. Tidepool restores them offline.
